today.desc: Turn free 12h Kaggle Dual-T4 GPUs into live remote terminals & detached job runners for AI Agents via MCP.
features: - Push static notebooks and wait blindly for completion, or
- Require manually pasting ngrok tokens into a browser cell, installing openssh-server, and fixing broken CUDA/LDLIBRARYPATH variables by hand.

- Zero Extra Accounts Required: Needs only KAGGLEUSERNAME and KAGGLEKEY (KGAT... bearer token or legacy key). No ngrok account, no VPN client required (optional Tailscale userspace mode is also supported).
- 100% Native CUDA Environment: Injects a pure-stdlib Python PTY & RPC daemon directly inside the Kaggle Kernel runtime—preserving Conda, PyTorch, PATH, and LDLIBRARYPATH out of the box.
- Agent-First Execution Split:
- termexec — Stateful /bin/bash PTY (preserves cd, export, virtualenvs) for fast interactive exploration and debugging.
- jobspawn / joblogs — Process-group isolated background jobs that survive network drops, with automatic tqdm carriage-return (\r) compaction so progress bars never blow up LLM context windows.
- Built-In Quota & Snapshot Watchdogs:

- Optional Idle Guard: Off by default (idletimeoutmin=0) so your worker stays ready up to 11h40m; pass idletimeoutmin=30 (or kgsh up --idle 30) to enable automatic shutdown when idle with < 3% GPU utilization.
today.trDesc: 通过 MCP，将免费的 12 小时 Kaggle 双 T4 GPU 转换为实时远程终端和独立作业运行器，用于 AI 代理。
today.trFeat:
- 推送静态笔记本并盲目等待完成，或者
- 需要手动将 ngrok 令牌粘贴到浏览器单元格中，安装 openssh-server，并手动修复损坏的 CUDA/LDLIBRARYPATH 变量。
- 无需额外账户：仅需 KAGGLEUSERNAME 和 KAGGLEKEY（KGAT... 承载者令牌或旧版密钥）。无需ngrok账户，也无需VPN客户端（还支持可选的Tailscale用户空间模式）。 - 100% 原生 CUDA 环境：直接在 Kaggle Kernel 运行时环境中注入纯 stdlib Python PTY 和 RPC 守护进程，开箱即用即可保留 Conda、PyTorch、PATH 和 LDLIBRARYPATH。
- 代理优先执行拆分：
- termexec — 有状态的 /bin/bash PTY（保留 cd、export、virtualenvs），用于快速的交互式探索和调试。 - jobspawn / joblogs — 进程组隔离的后台作业，能够经受网络中断，并采用自动 tqdm 回车符 (\r) 压缩，因此进度条绝不会撑爆 LLM 上下文窗口。
- 内置配额和快照看门狗：
- 可选的空闲保护：默认情况下处于关闭状态（idletimeoutmin=0），因此您的工作进程最多可保持就绪状态11小时40分钟； 传递 idletimeoutmin=30（或 kgsh up --idle 30）以在 GPU 利用率低于 3% 时处于空闲状态下启用自动关机。

- GPU: Metal in the hosted macOS runs on gpu/xnu-cpu-metal (metal2vulkan over Vulkan). Vulkan reaches the Linux
week.trDesc: XNU 作为 Linux 中的可加载内核模块（适用于 arm64 Linux 的 macOS 兼容层）

Mirror of Levent Alpöge's Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis (with Claude). All credit to Levent Alpöge. Source: alpo.ge
features: - RiemannHypothesis is Mathlib's own definition (Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/RiemannZeta.lean, line 185 at the pinned commit), so the headline statement comes from Mathlib, outside this repository:
- src/Statements.lean (16 lines, imports only Mathlib) defines the other four statements:
- RiemannZetaZerosOnLine: every zero of riemannZeta other than the trivial zeros -2(n+1) and s = 1 has real part 1/2
- DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf: for every Dirichlet character χ mod N, LFunction χ s ≠ 0 when Re s 1/2 (excluding χ = 1, s = 1)
- DirichletLZerosOnLine / PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine: zeros of Dirichlet L-functions in the critical strip lie on Re s = 1/2 (GRH for Dirichlet L-functions)
- The proof terms come from src/Supplements/Kernels/MainTheorems.lean:
week.trDesc: Levent Alpöge 对黎曼猜想的精益证明的镜像（与 Claude 一起）。所有功劳归于Levent Alpöge。来源：alpo.ge
week.trFeat:
- RiemannHypothesis 是 Mathlib 自己的定义（Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/RiemannZeta.lean，固定提交的第 185 行），因此标题命题来自 Mathlib，不在本代码仓库中：
- src/Statements.lean（16 行，仅导入 Mathlib）定义了另外四个命题：
- RiemannZetaZerosOnLine ： riemannZeta 的每个零点（平凡零点 -2(n+1) 和 s = 1 除外）的实部为 1/2 - DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf：对于每个狄利克雷（Dirichlet）特征 χ mod N，当 Re s 1/2 时，LFunction χ s ≠ 0（不包括 χ = 1, s = 1）
- DirichletLZerosOnLine / PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine：狄利克雷L函数的零点位于临界带的Re s = 1/2上（狄利克雷L函数的广义黎曼猜想）
